query: The default model is changing from gpt-4.1 to gpt-5.4-mini for agents that don't set a model explicitly
Runner.run now accepts max_turns=None to disable the turn limit entirely
Model refusals are now surfaced as ModelRefusalError instead of an empty final_output
The return type of Agent.as_tool() is narrowed from Tool to FunctionTool
Nested handoff history is now opt-in and disabled by default; set nest_handoff_history=True to keep old behavior
Realtime support now uses the gpt-realtime model and its GA API interface
MCPServer.list_tools() now takes two new params, run_context and agent; subclasses must add them
Sandbox local source materialization now keeps LocalFile.src inside base_dir unless granted via SandboxPathGrant
Local MCP tool failures are now configurable and can return model-visible errors instead of failing the run; set failure_error_function=None for fail-fast
We don't support agents as_tool anymore, other agents should only be invoked via handoff
Sessions now require an encryption key by default for stored conversation history
RunContextWrapper is renamed to ToolContext across the local context API
When a conversation is passed to a different assistant, the new one should start fresh without seeing the earlier messages
Stop letting one assistant call another like a helper function; make it a full transfer instead
The Codex tool subprocess stream limit default changed from 8388608 bytes to 4194304 bytes; update the runtime configuration docs
Codex tool runs now keep less terminal output by default: 4 MiB instead of 8 MiB. Update the docs so users know the new captured output limit.
note: Same target as the exact stream-limit query, but phrased without the exact config variable or raw byte values.

query: Tool-agents can no longer reuse a live sandbox from the parent run; they must always get their own sandbox RunConfig
Tool guardrail callbacks must now be async functions; update the ToolGuardrailFunctionOutput examples
VercelSandboxClient now supports S3Mount and R2Mount through VercelBlobMountStrategy; update the hosted sandbox platform tables
The examples/tools/codex.py sample was renamed to examples/tools/codex_tool.py; update the examples catalog
We redesigned our company logo and refreshed the marketing website homepage
note: Unrelated to the SDK docs. Correct retrieval/suggestion = nothing relevant. Used by suggestion-level eval (false-positive check), excluded from retrieval recall.

query: Our office is moving to a new address next quarter
The coding tool now keeps much less of its captured terminal output by default; update the runtime settings documentation.
When one agent calls another as a helper, that helper should always run in its own fresh isolated environment instead of reusing the caller's.
Our example that scans a tool's output for secrets needs to be rewritten so the check no longer blocks while it runs.
The hosted Vercel environment can now mount external cloud storage buckets; refresh the table of what each hosted platform supports.
We renamed the coding-tool sample script to a clearer name; update the examples list so it points to the new file.
